answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns a 50-coin deposit, like a comet burning up on entry, and only then gets tasks. The kernel of trust is the burned deposit: no deposit, no work, no reward. Forging 1,000 identities burns 50,000 coins, far above the diluted reward those slots could split, while one honest agent pays one burn and keeps its full reward; no ember of a spent identity can be reused.
